resources.string: Link this phone to your own wallpaper-rs server to share the library, playlists and settings with your computers. Nothing leaves the phone until you add a server.
Approve this code on a computer that is already linked, or at %s:
To read the synced data, this phone needs the sync key from a device that has it.
Waiting for %s: there, share the sync key with this phone.
Waiting for %s: there, choose to get the key from this phone.
This phone shows %1$s. Type the code that %2$s shows: the key moves only when both match.
The 6 digits shown on that device
Not end-to-end encrypted: the server can read the synced data
Approve only a code that your own new device shows on its screen. Someone who sends you a code is trying to get into your account.
A device on %1$s running %2$s asked for this code at %3$s.
Remove the server? This phone stops syncing and the server forgets it. The library on this phone stays.
Approving asks for the password of the account. An account that signs in through single sign-on approves on the account page of the server.
This account is synced by a newer version of wallpaper-rs: update the app to keep syncing.
Item names are keyed hashes. A device that once held the names key and has the same file can still tell that this account stores it, even after it is revoked.
This server uses its own certificate. Trust it only if this fingerprint is the one the server shows with wprs-server fingerprint:\n\n%1$s
A device that may know the recovery passphrase was revoked: set a new, different recovery passphrase.
